name: Concerns Resource
description: A security finding concerns a resource on the grid, keyed by that resource's natural key. The target is open: a Security Hub finding's Resources[].Id names any aws_core node keyed by that ARN, whatever its type (resolved from each model's ARN_RESOURCE and the vendored arn_formats.json, collectors/boto3_collector/arn_resolver.py, aws-core-tap#242), and an AwsEc2Instance by the instance id from the ARN. A GuardDuty finding names an EC2 instance by Resource.InstanceDetails.InstanceId, an S3 bucket by S3BucketDetails[].Arn, or an IAMUser access key's UserName (as arn:<partition>:iam::<account>:user/<name>, inferred: the default path); an Access Analyzer finding names its resource ARN for AWS::S3::Bucket, AWS::IAM::Role and AWS::IAM::User. Only the Security Hub finding is a source here: with the target open, a source listed here could point at any type, so the GuardDuty and Access Analyzer findings declare the edge on their own models (OUTBOUND_EDGES), which keep their targets to the types they name. A reference, not containment; it ends with the finding. Emitted whether or not the target was collected: it resolves by deterministic identity when it is. Collected by the landing-zone reader's findings half (collectors/boto3_collector/findings.py, aws-core-tap#76).
